broker.name: AMarkets
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2007. Its site names MISA (Mwali). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:3000.
broker.about: AMarkets says it has operated since 2007. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard, ECN, and Zero. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5. The site names these regulators: MISA (Mwali). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:3000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. MISA (Mwali): AMarkets LTD, T2023284.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, regulation page, about timeline and account page fetched. About page says the company was established in October 2007 under the brand Adrenalin Forex. Homepage says service since 2007. No page calls one city the headquarters. Cook Islands FSC and SVG FSA are described as registries, so they are not listed as brokerage regulators. A non-trading regulations search extract said the company does not charge inactivity fees and may archive a zero-balance account after 60 days with no activity. That page was not fetched, so the fee is unverified. Deposit-commission reimbursement was also only in a search extract and is not recorded as a confirmed fee.
